about: Every stage of both datasets, in dependency order. scripts/pipeline.py reads this file; docs/DATA_LINEAGE.md explains it. Paths are relative to the repository root. 'inputs' and 'code' are hashed into pipeline/pipeline.lock.json when a stage is built; a stage is stale when any of them changed since. 'config' lists curated settings files (hashed like code).

kinds.source: the data everything else is built from; corrected only through the tools in edited_by
kinds.recorded: built once outside this orchestrator (model calls, or inputs that are not committed); its committed outputs are the record
kinds.check: a check run by hand; never marked fresh without being run
kinds.runtime: something that runs live (a gateway, a replay server); has evidence, not build outputs

rebuild_modes.source: accepted as it is (hashed) when a rebuild starts from it
rebuild_modes.auto: run by scripts/pipeline.py rebuild when its requires are present
rebuild_modes.recorded: never re-run here; accepted as it is only when a rebuild starts from it or --accept-recorded is given
rebuild_modes.manual: never run here; the command is printed

stages.title: Data state & confidence assessment: the TE seed model
stages.treatment: Hand-transcribed from Downs & Vogel (1993); tag numbers assigned by this project, the XMEAS/XMV index kept on every item. Every item carries verification.status, and ops_review once someone reviews it.
stages.carries: verification.status per item (source check); ops_review.status and reviewer; open_question
stages.checked_by: scripts/verify_te_source.py (instruments and final elements) and scripts/verify_te_topology.py (units, streams, directions, ownership) against teprob.f

stages.title: Unit purposes: one plain-language sentence per TE unit, each citing the simulator lines it restates
stages.treatment: Written from teprob.f during the topology check; every sentence carries the line numbers it restates.
edited_by: edit data/te_unit_purposes.json by hand, then python scripts/test_te_topology.py
stages.carries: the citation per sentence; not reviewed by operations
stages.checked_by: scripts/test_te_topology.py (every citation is read against teprob.f)

stages.title: Source check report: the model against the simulator code
stages.requires_note: downloads teprob.f into data/external/te-braatz/ if it is not cached (network)
stages.treatment: Compares each instrument and final element's description and units with the simulator source; report only (no --write).
stages.carries: writes the verification.status the model then carries (with --write)
stages.checked_by: the script itself, line by line against teprob.f

stages.title: Topology check: units, streams, directions and tag ownership against the simulator code
stages.requires_note: downloads teprob.f and the revised TE code (temexd_mod.zip, N. L. Ricker's archive) into data/external/ if they are not cached (network)
stages.treatment: Reads the component balances, state mapping, pressure-driven flow lines and XMEAS/XCMP/VPOS lines out of teprob.f; cross-checks names with the revised code; report only (no --write).
stages.carries: writes the verification.status the model's units, streams and tag owners carry (with --write); 51 confirmed, 4 corrected, 1 unresolvable
stages.checked_by: scripts/test_te_topology.py (the parser on the pinned source, planted wrong answers)

stages.title: Control loops: read from the closed-loop code, checked against the recorded data, and scored on the generated drawing
stages.requires_note: needs temain_mod.f and d00_te.dat cached by scripts/fetch_te_data.py (network on first fetch)
stages.treatment: Each CONTRLn subroutine's error line gives the measurement and setpoint; its update line moves a valve or another loop's setpoint (a cascade). The CALL lines give which loops run and how often. File comments are ignored. Measurements and valves are named with the model's assigned tags.
stages.carries: 19 running loops (11 valve, 8 cascade), the purge override on separator pressure; the data check (every controlled variable within 0.34 SD of its setpoint in d00_te.dat); the drawing audit score for data/te_pid/key.json
stages.checked_by: scripts/test_te_control_loops.py (pinned pairings, a rotated-pairing negative control for the data check, and pass/fail controls for the drawing audit)

stages.title: Platform exports: Ignition tags, PI Builder sheet (schema v2), SVGs, operations review sheet
stages.treatment: One model, every format: structural validation first, nothing written on failure.
stages.carries: Ignition tag documentation and PI attribute descriptions end with '| source check: <status> | ops review: <status>'; the review sheet's model_status and OPS_ columns
stages.checked_by: scripts/test_generate_validation.py, scripts/test_apply_review.py, scripts/test_pi_mapping.py; the PI sheet is checked offline by pi.export_check and has never been imported into a PI System

stages.title: Overview mimic layout (offline)
stages.treatment: Renders the overview with the same function the Ignition build uses and keeps, per reading: the unit it is drawn beside, where, and the tag path it reads.
stages.carries: each reading: the provenance of its model item; positions and the choice of readings are first-pass display choices
stages.checked_by: scripts/test_process_mimic.py, scripts/test_pipeline.py; the full screens were checked in a disposable gateway (README); not reviewed by operations

stages.title: 3D scene data and inferred LOTO candidates
stages.treatment: Equipment, tags, ownership and stream ends copied from the model; positions are the 2D layout scaled; sizes, elevations and pipe routes are placeholders; LOTO candidates are inferred (valves on streams touching a unit).
stages.carries: every unit, tag, pipe and LOTO candidate: the provenance of its model item; geometry is marked placeholder; LOTO is marked inferred and not a procedure
stages.checked_by: scripts/test_pipeline.py (that it follows the model). The 3D tour that renders it is te.tour (proof of concept)

stages.title: Learned normal bands from the recorded normal run
stages.requires_note: hash-verified TE replay files: python scripts/fetch_te_data.py (network)
stages.treatment: Mean +/- K standard deviations on the first half of the normal run; K chosen on the second half; the fault run chooses nothing.
stages.carries: statistics on published data; one operating mode assumed
stages.checked_by: the held-out half of the normal run and the fault-6 run (docs/OPERATOR_SCREENS.md)

stages.title: Fault evaluation: the shipped normal bands and a PCA T2 baseline on all 21 TE faults
stages.requires_note: the full Braatz set, 44 hash-verified files: python scripts/fetch_te_data.py --all (network)
stages.treatment: Detection rule fixed before any fault file was scored (3 consecutive flagged samples); the bands are not retuned; false alarms on normal running the bands never fitted on.
stages.carries: 17/21 detected, 0 false alarm events in 193 h; one operating mode, simulated data; the band flag is a display aid, not an alarm
stages.checked_by: scripts/test_fault_detection_eval.py (regenerates the committed results exactly; synthetic controls for the rule, the F quantile and the PCA)

stages.title: Data state & confidence assessment: the 12 OPEN100 drawings and their answer keys
stages.treatment: Third-party drawings with third-party answer keys (symbol classes, boxes, connections; no tag text). Sheets 0-5 are the development set, 6-11 the sealed holdout A.
stages.carries: answer keys are the ground truth for symbols and connections only
stages.checked_by: the PID2Graph authors; the scorer's positive and negative controls (scripts/test_scorer_controls.py)

stages.title: Generated P&ID: the TE model drawn in the OPEN100 house style, with answer keys emitted from the same model
stages.requires_note: Pillow (PNG bytes can differ between Pillow versions; the manifest records the version)
stages.treatment: Draws only what the model holds, where the drafting layout puts it; refuses a layout that drops, duplicates or invents a model item. Lines the model has no stream for are drafting additions, marked in the key.
stages.carries: every symbol's model reference (model_ref); a generated drawing is not a drawing of record
stages.checked_by: scripts/test_te_pid_roundtrip.py; the code line tracer recovers every key link from the key's own boxes

stages.title: Generated TE sheets, revision A (archived): the sheets the recorded extraction runs read
stages.treatment: The three sheets and their keys exactly as scripts/draw_pid_from_model.py drew them on 2026-10-13 (no controllers, valves numbered 201-212), archived from git on 2026-10-28 when revision B added the control loops (journal entry 51). Byte-identical to the files the recorded extraction stages hashed when they ran. Never regenerated: revision B is te.pid.
stages.carries: revision A: 0 of 19 control loops drawn (out/te_loop_audit.md, journal entry 50)
stages.checked_by: pipeline lock hashes recorded by te.pid_extract and te.pid_roundtrip before the archive

stages.title: Style check: the generated sheets against the 12 OPEN100 sheets
stages.requires_note: numpy, opencv-python-headless, Pillow
stages.treatment: The same measurements on every sheet, nothing tuned per sheet; a value sits inside the style when it is within the OPEN100 per-sheet range.
stages.carries: 32 of 36 measurements inside the OPEN100 range; the four outside are symbol counts and ink coverage (the model has no drains, vents or manual valves)
stages.checked_by: the measurements are reported, not gated

stages.title: Extraction of the generated sheets (recorded): clean and degraded copies, five or three runs per model (revision A sheets, data/te_pid/rev-a)
stages.requires_note: model calls (Codex and Claude CLIs) with PID_SHEETS_DIR=data/te_pid/rev-a; run records are not committed
stages.treatment: Method M3 unchanged (2x2 tiles, 0.15 overlap, prompt_v2, then the code line tracer).
stages.carries: per item: the model's confidence and the source run
stages.checked_by: the frozen scorer, through te.pid_roundtrip

stages.title: Round-trip check: symbols, tag text and connections read back from the generated sheets (revision A sheets, data/te_pid/rev-a)
stages.requires_note: the run records under runs/ (not committed)
stages.treatment: The frozen scorer for symbols and connections; tag text matched by position and compared after dropping case and separators; means with min-max and 95% t-intervals.
stages.carries: an UPPER BOUND for clean house-style drawings: the keys come from the same model as the drawings; not real-plant accuracy and not comparable with OPEN100
stages.checked_by: scripts/test_te_pid_roundtrip.py

stages.title: Extraction of the revision C sheets (recorded): the same frozen method and protocol as revision A, labels tec-*
stages.requires_note: model calls (Codex and Claude CLIs on their subscriptions) via python scripts/run_te_roundtrip.py --tool codex|claude; run records are not committed
stages.treatment: Method M3 unchanged (2x2 tiles, 0.15 overlap, prompt_v2, then the code line tracer).
stages.carries: GPT: 42 sheet runs, 0 failed tiles (2026-10-28). Claude: not run yet (its CLI sign-in had expired)
stages.checked_by: the frozen scorer, through te.pid_roundtrip

stages.title: Round-trip check on the revision C sheets (controllers, signal lines and valve stations drawn)
stages.requires_note: the run records under runs/ (not committed)
stages.treatment: The frozen scorer for symbols and connections; tag text matched by position and compared after dropping case and separators; means with min-max and 95% t-intervals.
stages.carries: GPT only so far: clean review load 1.26 per 100, every tag read; L3 14.9 per 100, 9% of tags read
stages.checked_by: scripts/test_te_pid_roundtrip.py

stages.title: Extracted TE twins (recorded): one per declared run, plus the key fed in as a perfect extraction (revision A sheets, data/te_pid/rev-a)
stages.requires_note: the run records under runs/ (not committed), PID_SHEETS_DIR=data/te_pid/rev-a
stages.treatment: The same converter as OPEN100; every item starts unverified.
stages.carries: verification.status (unverified), risk.tier, tag_status
stages.checked_by: te.pid_diff against the verified model

stages.title: Exports of the extracted TE twins: review queue, Ignition tags, PI sheet, SVG

stages.carries: every description carries the item's confidence and UNVERIFIED
stages.checked_by: scripts/test_te_pid_roundtrip.py; not imported into a gateway

stages.title: Reviewer diff: each extracted TE twin against the verified model

stages.carries: the corrections a reviewer would make; 9 of the 10 on the declared chain come from the converter, not the reading (diff_key)
stages.checked_by: scripts/test_te_pid_roundtrip.py

stages.title: Extraction: models read symbols and tags (2x2 tiles), code traces the lines

stages.treatment: Method M3, chosen by a rule written before the holdouts were scored.
stages.carries: per item: the model's confidence and the source run; scored per set against the answer keys

stages.title: Scorecards against the answer keys
stages.requires_note: the run records under runs/ (not committed)
stages.treatment: Rules fixed before any run; failures count as zero.
stages.carries: set-level accuracy (review load, F1 by class); it does not say which individual item is right
stages.checked_by: scripts/test_scorer_controls.py (the scorer must fail deliberately wrong answers)

stages.title: Round 5: five replicate runs per tool on holdout A, with run and bootstrap intervals
stages.requires_note: model calls (Codex and Claude CLIs); run records are not committed
stages.treatment: Pre-registered in docs/GOAL.md before the runs; a failed drawing scores as zero, never re-run to replace it.
stages.carries: GPT 20.1, Claude 29.8 review load per 100; GPT minus Claude is beyond run noise on these 6 sheets and a tie across drawings
stages.checked_by: scripts/test_replicate_stats.py (interval arithmetic on synthetic cases)

stages.title: Asset model: sheets to hierarchy, risk-tiered review queue
stages.requires_note: the run records under runs/ (not committed); after building, review decisions are applied to this file in place
stages.treatment: Deterministic conversion; every item starts unverified, gets a risk tier and a plain-language reason. Review corrections and I/O mappings are then applied to this file by the edited_by tools.

stages.checked_by: scripts/score_twin.py (parent assignment), scripts/score_triage.py (risk tiers) on the holdouts

stages.title: Platform exports: review queue, Ignition tags, PI AF sheet, SVG overlays

stages.checked_by: scripts/test_generate_validation.py, scripts/test_export_review_boundaries.py, scripts/test_pi_mapping.py

stages.title: Timed-review kit for sheet 8 (no measurement yet)

stages.title: Offline PI check: the PI Builder sheets against what AVEVA publishes (not an import test)
stages.treatment: Compares headers, ObjectType values, the Parent convention, value types and default UOMs with the vendor-published conventions in the reference file; fails only on internal inconsistencies or values outside the documented sheets.
stages.carries: offline-checked only: it cannot say a file will import; no PI System was used
stages.checked_by: scripts/test_check_pi_export.py (positive controls)

stages.title: Ignition gateway kit: tag provider, alarms, 24-view Perspective project (mimic, sheet screens, narrow /m overview)

stages.treatment: TE tags with published alarm setpoints and learned bands; data-source diagnostic alarms (setpoint 0.5: AboveValue is inclusive) and an active-alarm count in the header; the extracted twin as placeholders that read 'not connected'; ReviewStatus member on every tag; a 390 px overview at /m.
stages.carries: a ReviewStatus member per tag (ops review); placeholders stay Bad quality, never a false Good
stages.checked_by: scripts/ignition/verify_gateway.py V1-V8 with planted faults, and the native acceptance run (ignition.acceptance) in a disposable gateway (lab result, not site acceptance)

stages.title: 3D operator orientation tour: review stills, measured label boxes and the render verification
stages.requires_note: BLENDER_EXE: a Blender executable (rendered with Blender 5.2.2; stills only, no video); the fault-6 replay for the fault stills (python scripts/fetch_te_data.py); Pillow

Blender's renders can differ by a few grey levels between runs (two of the five JPEGs did, max 7 of 255), so a rebuild may rewrite the stills; the measured label boxes and the verification report came out identical.
stages.carries: PROOF OF CONCEPT: placeholder geometry, recorded replay, inferred LOTO points (not a procedure), a Claude-written script not reviewed by an operator
stages.checked_by: scripts/test_build_3d_scene.py (contract, hygiene with HAZARD_DENY_TERMS), scripts/test_verify_3d_render.py; verify_3d_render.py: no check fails on the twelve stills (15 pass, 2 informational) (exports, topology from geometry, legibility); OCR read-back not re-run (drafts/3d-tour/REVIEW_NOTES.md)

stages.title: Interactive browser process tour (anatomy-style cutaway): data export, page build, geometry audit and verification
stages.requires_note: the recorded normal and fault-6 replays (python scripts/fetch_te_data.py); Node.js 20.10+ on PATH; a Chrome or Chromium for verify.mjs (CHROME_PATH, or a Playwright browser cache); optional TOUR_DENY_TERMS for the publication hygiene check

stages.carries: PROOF OF CONCEPT: placeholder geometry, recorded replay, inferred LOTO points (not a procedure), text written with AI assistance and not reviewed by an operator
stages.checked_by: drafts/interactive-tour/verify.mjs (topology and tags against the raw model, P&ID key, Ignition and PI AF exports and replay files; the anatomy kit geometry audit; legibility at 390 and 1440 px in both themes; behaviour drive)

stages.title: Live replay: recorded TE runs drive the gateway
stages.requires_note: a running Ignition 8.3 gateway (docs/IGNITION_BUILD.md) and the TE replay files
stages.treatment: Replays recorded simulator output; it is not a process simulator and does not respond to control changes.

stages.treatment: Third-party example drawings (CC BY 4.0) pinned to one commit; the files are downloaded and hash-checked, not committed. Three sheets carry DEXPI XML geometry and labels; two carry published tag lists.
stages.carries: tag text truth for five clean sheets from one publisher
stages.checked_by: the pinned hashes

stages.title: DEXPI drawings to answer keys (recorded: needs the download and MuPDF)
stages.requires_note: network and PyMuPDF; outputs stay in the gitignored data/external/dexpi/
stages.treatment: Conversion rules written before any model saw a DEXPI image (in the script's docstring); nozzles, actuators and other internals are not separate symbols.
stages.carries: the key scope decides part of the score (nozzles drawn but not DEXPI items)
stages.checked_by: scripts/test_dexpi_adapter.py (a converted key scores itself perfectly)

stages.title: Round 5 on DEXPI: five replicate runs per tool, symbols, connections and tag text
stages.requires_note: model calls and the DEXPI download; run records are not committed
stages.treatment: Pre-registered in docs/GOAL.md; tag scoring rules dated in score_tags.py before any run.
stages.carries: clean vector drawings from one publisher; says nothing about scans or real archives
stages.checked_by: scripts/test_score_tags.py, scripts/test_replicate_stats.py

stages.title: Bayer residue treater: process model, Figure 10 inventory, drafting layout and Figure 11 calibration, written from the CSB report
stages.treatment: Every unit, stream, instrument, valve, controller, interlock, limit and event cites the report's page or figure. The report gives no tag numbers for the residue treater, so every tag is assigned by this project and marked so. The calibration is read off Figure 11's own axes, gridlines and ticks only. The Figure 10 inventory records what that figure shows (equipment, transmitters, valves, lines), read from the figure alone; the drafting layout says only where things go on the generated sheet.
edited_by: edit data/bayer_rt/*.json by hand, then python scripts/test_bayer_rt.py
stages.carries: a page or figure citation per item; assigned_tag on every tag; open questions (which temperature Fig 11 plots)
stages.checked_by: scripts/test_bayer_rt.py (citations, assigned tags, references between items)

stages.title: Generated P&ID of the residue treater: the model drawn in the house style, with controllers and interlocks
stages.requires_note: Pillow (PNG bytes can differ between Pillow versions; the manifest records the version)
stages.treatment: The same generator as the TE sheets. Draws only what the model holds: every instrument, control valve, hand valve, relief valve, controller and interlock exactly once, with every signal the model implies; refuses a layout that drops or duplicates one. No control valve stations: Figure 10 draws none.
stages.carries: assigned tags only (the report gives none); an answer key in the PID2Graph schema
stages.checked_by: scripts/compare_bayer_fig10.py (the drawn lines against Figure 10); scripts/test_bayer_rt.py

stages.title: The model and the generated drawing against the report's Figure 10
stages.treatment: Figure 10 has no tags, so the check is at the level it is drawn: every figure unit is a model unit; every figure line is a model stream with the same ends and the same types and numbers of items; then every figure line is traced through the drawn sheet's answer key, end to end, counting what is drawn on it.
stages.carries: model 20 of 21 (the one difference: a blind-flanged nozzle whose purpose the report doesn't state); drawing 15 of 15 lines
stages.checked_by: scripts/test_bayer_rt.py (planted faults: a moved transmitter, a cut line, a swapped valve type)

stages.title: Figure 11 digitized: the residue treater's DCS trend, checked against the report's text
stages.requires_note: downloads the CSB report into data/external/csb/ if absent (network) and needs PyMuPDF
stages.treatment: Colour classification per series, gridlines and two annotation boxes removed, small black components dropped, median row per pixel column; time and values from the calibration. Then 11 checks against values the report states, never used to calibrate.
stages.carries: one row per pixel column (about 32 s) with min/median/max per series and the pixel-error bound; 8 of 11 checks pass, the 3 disagreements explained
stages.checked_by: the 11 text checks in out/bayer_rt/fig11_check.md; scripts/test_bayer_rt.py
